name: Training Program for A-HELP Women Workers - Uttarakhand Livestock Development Board
benefit: Under this scheme, community-service-based job creation or job filling is carried out between the Animal Husbandry Department and Animal Husbandry by A-HELP workers.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a woman member of a self-help group formed under the Uttarakhand State Rural Livelihood Mission. 1. The applicant must have a minimum educational qualification of eighth pass. 1. The applicant must have completed 7 days of Pashu Sakhi training.
